<ftp>

FTP connection container processor

External FTP v2.2.0

Overview

The processor establishes an FTP/FTPS connection and provides it to child processors (, , ). Supports passive mode, authentication, and binary/text transfers.

Important Notes

  • Passive mode:: Enabled by default for firewall compatibility
  • Connection reuse:: Single connection shared by all child operations
  • Thread safety:: Not thread-safe - use one FTP block per thread
  • FTPS support:: Use port 990 for implicit SSL

Related Processors

<ftp-get> <ftp-put> <ftp-list> <file>
